## I JUDGMENTS AND ORDERS

## Scope of this section

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > Scope of this section] 40.1 This Section sets out rules about judgments and orders which apply except where any other of these Rules or a practice direction makes a different provision in relation to the judgment or order in question. ## Standard requirements

## 40.2

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.2] (1) Every judgment or order must state the name and judicial title of the person who made it, unless it is –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.2] (a) default judgment entered under rule 12.4(1) (entry of default judgment where judgment is entered by a court officer) or a default costs certificate obtained under rule 47.11;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.2] (b) judgment on admission entered under Part 14 where judgment is entered by a court officer;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.2] (c) a consent order under rule 40.6(2) (consent orders made by court officers);

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.2] (d) an order made by a court officer under rule 70.5 (orders to enforce awards as if payable under a court order); or

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.2] (e) an order made by a court officer under rule 71.2 (orders to obtain information from judgment debtors). [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.2] (2) Every judgment or order must –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.2] (a) bear the date on which it is given or made; and

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.2] (b) be sealed (GL) by the court. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.2] (3) Paragraph (4) applies where a party applies for permission to appeal against a judgment or order at the hearing at which the judgment or order was made or any adjournment of that hearing. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.2] (4) Where this paragraph applies, the judgment or order shall state –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.2] (a) omitted;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.2] (b) whether an appeal lies from the judgment or order and, if so, to which appeal court, with an indication of the division of the High Court where the High Court is the appeal court;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.2] (c) whether the court gives permission to appeal; and

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.2] (d) if not, the appropriate appeal court, including the appropriate division where relevant, to which any further application for permission may be made.(Paragraph 4.3B of Practice Direction 52 deals with the court’s power to adjourn a hearing where a judgment or order is handed down and no application for permission to appeal is made at that hearing)

## Drawing up and filing of judgments and orders

## 40.3

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.3] (1) Except as is provided at paragraph (4) below or by any Practice Direction, every judgment or order will be drawn up by the court unless –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.3] (a) the court orders a party to draw it up;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.3] (b) a party, with the permission of the court, agrees to draw it up;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.3] (c) the court dispenses with the need to draw it up; or

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.3] (d) it is a consent order under rule 40.6. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.3] (2) The court may direct that –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.3] (a) a judgment or an order drawn up by a party must be checked by the court before it is sealed (GL) ; or

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.3] (b) before a judgment or an order is drawn up by the court, the parties must file an agreed statement of its terms. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.3] (3) Where a judgment or an order is to be drawn up by a party –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.3] (a) he must file it no later than 7 days after the date on which the court ordered or permitted him to draw it up so that it can be sealed (GL) by the court; and

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.3] (b) if he fails to file it within that period, any other party may draw it up and file it. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.3] (4) Except for orders made by the court of its own initiative and unless the court otherwise orders, every judgment or order made in claims proceeding in the King’s Bench Division at the Royal Courts of Justice, other than in the Administrative Court, will be drawn up by the parties, and rule 40.3 is modified accordingly. ## Service of judgments and orders

## 40.4

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.4] (1) Where a judgment or an order has been drawn up by a party and is to be served by the court –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.4] (a) the party who drew it up must file a copy to be retained at court and sufficient copies for service on him and on the other parties; and

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.4] (b) once it has been sealed (GL) , the court must serve a copy of it on each party to the proceedings. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.4] (2) Unless the court directs otherwise, any order made otherwise than at trial must be served on –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.4] (a) the applicant and the respondent; and

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.4] (b) any other person on whom the court orders it to be served. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.4] (Rule 6.21 sets out who is to serve a document other than the claim form.)

## Power to require judgment or order to be served on a party as well as his solicitor

## 40.5

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.5] Where the party on whom a judgment or order is to be served is acting by a solicitor, the court may order the judgment or order to be served on the party as well as on his solicitor. ## Consent judgments and orders

## 40.6

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (1) This rule applies where all the parties agree the terms in which a judgment should be given or an order should be made. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (2) A court officer may enter and seal (GL) an agreed judgment or order if –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (a) the judgment or order is listed in paragraph (3);

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (b) none of the parties is a litigant in person; and

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (c) the approval of the court is not required by these Rules, a practice direction or any enactment before an agreed order can be made. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (3) The judgments and orders referred to in paragraph (2) are –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (a) a judgment or order for –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (i) the payment of an amount of money (including a judgment or order for damages or the value of goods to be decided by the court); or

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (ii) the delivery up of goods with or without the option of paying the value of the goods or the agreed value. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (b) an order for –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (i) the dismissal of any proceedings, wholly or in part;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (ii) the stay (GL) of proceedings on agreed terms, disposing of the proceedings, whether those terms are recorded in a schedule to the order or elsewhere;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (iii) the stay of enforcement of a judgment, either unconditionally or on condition that the money due under the judgment is paid by instalments specified in the order;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (iv) the setting aside under Part 13 of a default judgment which has not been satisfied;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (v) the payment out of money which has been paid into court;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (vi) the discharge from liability of any party;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (vii) the payment, assessment or waiver of costs, or such other provision for costs as may be agreed. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (4) Rule 40.3 (drawing up and filing of judgments and orders) applies to judgments and orders entered and sealed by a court officer under paragraph (2) as it applies to other judgments and orders. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (5) Where paragraph (2) does not apply, any party may apply for a judgment or order in the terms agreed. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (6) The court may deal with an application under paragraph (5) without a hearing. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (7) Where this rule applies –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (a) the order which is agreed by the parties must be drawn up in the terms agreed;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (b) it must be expressed as being ‘By Consent’;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.6] (c) it must be signed by the legal representative acting for each of the parties to whom the order relates or, where paragraph (5) applies, by the party if he is a litigant in person. ## When judgment or order takes effect

## 40.7

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.7] (1) A judgment or order takes effect from the day when it is given or made, or such later date as the court may specify. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.7] (2) This rule applies to all judgments and orders except those to which rule 40.10 (judgment against a State) applies. ## Time from which interest begins to run

## 40.8

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.8] (1) Where interest is payable on a judgment pursuant to section 17 of the Judgments Act 1838 1 or section 74 of the County Courts Act 1984 2 , the interest shall begin to run from the date that judgment is given unless –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.8] (a) a rule in another Part or a practice direction makes different provision; or

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.8] (b) the court orders otherwise. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.8] (2) The court may order that interest shall begin to run from a date before the date that judgment is given. ## Stay of execution and other relief

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > Stay of execution and other relief] 40.8A Without prejudice to rule 83.7(1), a party against whom a judgment has been given or an order made may apply to the court for—

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > Stay of execution and other relief] (a) a stay of execution of the judgment or order; or

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > Stay of execution and other relief] (b) other relief,

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > Stay of execution and other relief] on the ground of matters which have occurred since the date of the judgment or order, and the court may by order grant such relief, and on such terms, as it thinks just. ## Who may apply to set aside or vary a judgment or order

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > Who may apply to set aside or vary a judgment or order] 40.9 A person who is not a party but who is directly affected by a judgment or order may apply to have the judgment or order set aside or varied. ## County Court judgments and orders – variation of payment

## 40.9A

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (1) In this rule— (a) ‘creditor’ means the person entitled to the benefit of a judgment or order;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (b) ‘debtor’ means the person liable to make the payment under the judgment or order; and

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (c) ‘debtor’s home court’ means the court, or County Court hearing centre, serving the address of the debtor. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (2) Where a judgment or order has been given or made in the County Court for the payment of money, the creditor or, as the case may be, the debtor may apply in accordance with this rule for a variation in the date or rate of payment. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (3) The creditor may apply in writing, without notice being served on any other party, for an order that the money—

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (a) if payable in one sum, be paid—

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (i) at a later date than that by which it is due; or

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (ii) by instalments; or

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (b) if already payable by instalments, be paid by the same or smaller instalments,

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] and the court officer may make an order accordingly, subject to paragraph (4). [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (4) If no payment has been made under the judgment or order for 6 years before the date of the application, the court officer must refer the application to the District Judge. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (5) The creditor may apply to the District Judge in writing and on notice for an order that the money—

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (a) if payable in one sum, be paid at an earlier date than that by which it is due; or

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (b) if payable by instalments, be paid in one sum or by larger instalments. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (6) Any application under paragraph (5) must state the proposed terms and the grounds on which it is made. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (7) Where an application is made under paragraph (5)—

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (a) the proceedings will be automatically transferred to the debtor’s home court if the judgment or order was not given or made in that court; and

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (b) the court officer will fix a day for the hearing of the application before the District Judge and give to the creditor and the debtor not less than 8 days’ notice of the day so fixed. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (8) The debtor may apply for an order that the money—

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (a) if payable in one sum, be paid at a later date than that by which it is due or by instalments; or

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (b) if already payable by instalments, be paid by smaller instalments. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (9) Any application under paragraph (8) must—

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (a) be in the appropriate form;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (b) state the proposed terms;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (c) state the grounds on which it is made; and

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (d) include a signed statement of the debtor’s means. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (10) Where an application is made under paragraph (8), the court officer will—

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (a) send the creditor a copy of the debtor’s application and statement of means; and

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (b) require the creditor to notify the court in writing, within 14 days of service of notification, giving reasons for any objection the creditor may have to the granting of the application. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (11) If the creditor does not notify the court of any objection within the time stated, the court officer will make an order in the terms applied for. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (12) Upon receipt of a notice from the creditor under paragraph (10), the court officer may determine the date and rate of payment and make an order accordingly. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (13) Any party affected by an order made under paragraph (12) may, within 14 days of service of the order and giving reasons, apply on notice for the order to be re-considered and, where such an application is made—

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (a) the proceedings will be automatically transferred to the debtor’s home court if the judgment or order was not given or made in that court; and

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (b) the court officer shall fix a day for the hearing of the application before the District Judge and give to the creditor and the debtor not less than 8 days’ notice of the day so fixed. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (14) On hearing an application under paragraph (13), the District Judge may confirm the order or set it aside and make such new order as the District Judge thinks fit and the order so made will be entered in the records of the court. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.9A] (15) Any order made under any of the foregoing paragraphs may be varied from time to time by a subsequent order made under any of those paragraphs. ## Judgment against a State in default of acknowledgment of service

## 40.10

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.10] (1) Where the claimant obtains default judgment under Part 12 on a claim against a State where the defendant has failed to file an acknowledgment of service, the judgment does not take effect until 2 months after service on the State of –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.10] (a) a copy of the judgment; and

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.10] (b) a copy of the evidence in support of the application for permission to enter default judgment (unless the evidence has already been served on the State in accordance with an order made under Part 12). [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.10] (2) In this rule, ‘State’ has the meaning given by section 14 of the State Immunity Act 1978 3 . ## Time for complying with a judgment or order

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > Time for complying with a judgment or order] 40.11 A party must comply with a judgment or order for the payment of an amount of money (including costs) within 14 days of the date of the judgment or order, unless –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > Time for complying with a judgment or order] (a) the judgment or order specifies a different date for compliance (including specifying payment by instalments);

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > Time for complying with a judgment or order] (b) any of these Rules specifies a different date for compliance; or

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > Time for complying with a judgment or order] (c) the court has stayed the proceedings or judgment. ## Correction of errors in judgments and orders

## 40.12

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.12] (1) The court may at any time correct an accidental slip or omission in a judgment or order. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.12] (2) A party may apply for a correction without notice. ## Cases where court gives judgment both on claim and counterclaim

## 40.13

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.13] (1) This rule applies where the court gives judgment for specified amounts both for the claimant on his claim and against the claimant on a counterclaim. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.13] (2) If there is a balance in favour of one of the parties, it may order the party whose judgment is for the lesser amount to pay the balance. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.13] (3) In a case to which this rule applies, the court may make a separate order as to costs against each party. ## County Court set-off of cross-judgments

## 40.13A

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.13A] (1) This rule applies to applications under section 72 of the County Courts Act 1984 4 for permission to set off any sums, including costs, payable under several judgments or orders each of which was obtained in the County Court. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.13A] (2) Where the judgments or orders have been obtained in the same County Court hearing centre, the application—

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.13A] (a) may be made to that hearing centre on the day when the last judgment or order is obtained, if both parties are present; and

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.13A] (b) in any other case must be made on notice. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.13A] (3) Where the judgments or orders have been obtained in different County Court hearing centres, the application may be made to any of them on notice. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.13A] (4) The District Judge located at the hearing centre to which the application is made will—

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.13A] (a) forthwith stay execution on any judgment or order to which the application relates; and

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.13A] (b) notify any hearing centre that made the relevant judgments or orders of the stay. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.13A] (5) Where execution has been stayed under paragraph (4), any money paid into court under the judgment or order will be retained until the application has been disposed of and the court has directed how any money paid into court is to be dealt with. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.13A] (6) Paragraphs (7) and (8) apply where an order is made by the High Court giving permission to set off sums payable under several judgments and orders obtained respectively in the High Court and the County Court. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.13A] (7) The High Court will send to the County Court a copy of the order giving permission, and the County Court will deal with any money paid into court in accordance with that order.
